backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods defined.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report listing three Valentine-related frontend features and the files they modify.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the main app, styles, Tailwind config, and the Moments page.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base theme defining OKLCH variables and dark‑mode overrides for layout and color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component showing a romantic message carousel, final‑slide Yes/No logic, and navigation to the Moments page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication provider and hook managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and status states.
frontend/src/index.css: Extended Tailwind theme with romantic color variables, dark mode overrides, and custom animations like floating hearts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry script initializing QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and rendering the App component.
frontend/src/pages/Moments.tsx: React page displaying a romantic-themed layout with backgrounds, floating hearts, a message card, and a photo gallery; includes a back button handler.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and theme settings including custom romantic color palette and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing requirements for a Moments page, issues with missing uploaded photos, and feature request statuses.
